card.at_dispenser_brief:
Fires high-damage firework rockets forward, causing explosions on hit.
Must be planted on a Dispenser.
card.at_dispenser_starshards: Fires a short-fuse firework rocket forward, releasing cluster bombs upon destruction.
card.at_dispenser_story: Deploys a HellVillager to operate a powerful manual turret that can destroy long-range armored targets.
card.bouncing_anvil_brief:
Bouncing Anvil is fitted with a powerful spring. When a ground enemy comes near, it leaps high and slams into them.
On landing it deals damage with an invisible laser, then the anvil shatters.
Its warning line extends 1.4 tiles to the left and right of its planting center. Only ground enemies that are not flying and not in the void trigger it.
card.bouncing_anvil_starshards: Two clones leap at the two highest-HP enemies on the field, each taking 2 hits in a 0.8-tile area (does not scale with level). With no enemies, one clone hops in place and returns. Does not consume the anvil.
card.bouncing_anvil_advance-5: Summons a clone to the left; laser length increases to 1.5 tiles
card.dispenser_brief:
Dispensers are your first line of defense, firing arrows to protect your house.
Damage: Medium.
card.dispenser_starshards: Fires a large volley of arrows forward.
card.dispenser_story:
One of the devices Alex found in Steve's leftover device box.
Blacksmith: Seems he only used this device in Chapter 1.
card.dispenser_advance-3: All arrows can penetrate one target, dealing 50% damage penalty per penetration
card.dispenser_advance-5: Star Fragment ability arrows penetrate one additional target
card.double_dispenser_brief: Double Dispenser can attack ground units in both front and back simultaneously.
card.double_dispenser_starshards: Fires a large volley of arrows forward and rapid-fire rockets backward.
card.double_dispenser_story:
Blacksmith: Double Dispenser is an expert at eliminating backline enemies, so you won't need Elastic Pudding. Saves both card slots and energy!
Alex: But I want to bring both anyway.
Blacksmith: 😅
card.double_dispenser_advance-7: Fires 1 more bullet both forward and backward
card.elastic_putin_brief:
Elastic Pudding can bounce back your own arrows, rockets, and other projectiles.
Photosensitive crop, cannot bounce when sleeping.
card.elastic_putin_starshards: Immediately wakes up, becomes electrified for a short time, adding lightning attribute to arrows to cause small explosions.
card.elastic_putin_story: Elastic Pudding is a distant cousin of Elastic Cloud. Compared to bouncing enemy projectiles, Elastic Pudding prefers bouncing your own, allowing your frontal firepower to easily eliminate backline enemy harassment.
card.elastic_putin_advance-7: Star Fragment ability electrified duration increased
card.furnace_brief: Furnace automatically produces redstone energy for you.
card.furnace_starshards: Generates a large amount of redstone.
card.furnace_story:
One of the devices Alex found in Steve's leftover device box.
Blacksmith installed a minecart rail connected to a generator on the original furnace, automatically converting redstone into mechanical energy.
Blacksmith: Because the developer lacks skill, all resources in this game are automatically collected.
card.generator_brief:
When attacked by zombies, converts damage taken into energy.
Photosensitive crop, energy conversion efficiency greatly reduced when sleeping.
Low-profile device.
card.generator_starshards: Wakes up all devices in a 3x3 area.
card.generator_story: While organizing Steve's leftover devices, the blacksmith found a daylight sensor. With the photovoltaic panel damaged, he added a foot pedal to generate power from monster attacks. But at what cost?
card.generator_advance-3: Energy conversion efficiency moderately increased in strong sunlight
card.glow_powder_brief:
Glowstone Powder can wake up sleeping devices.
Cannot use Star Fragments on this.
Powder-form device can be placed freely on any tile with a carrier.
card.glow_powder_story: Will one ever wake from a dream of meeting the Witch of Love?
card.ice_bomb_brief:
Explodes and freezes all enemies on screen, slowing them for a period after thawing.
Photosensitive crop, cannot activate immediately when planted during the day.
card.ice_bomb_starshards: Only activates while sleeping, exploding and freezing all enemies on screen for a longer duration.
card.ice_bomb_story: Ice Bomb has been trying to break free from its stereotype as a control card. Through intense training, it now deals damage.
card.lily_brief: Provides a platform for you to plant devices on water.
card.lily_starshards: Plants Water Lilies in a 3x3 water area.
card.lily_story: The 8th, 18th, and 28th of each month are Love Lily Days!
card.magic_powder_brief:
Deals high (laser attribute) damage to all monsters in a tile and grants one Star Fragment.
Cannot use Star Fragments on this.
Powder-form device can be placed freely on any tile with a carrier.
card.magic_powder_story: While building a mob farm in the Eternal Night Swamp to solve the monster loot shortage, a magic box was discovered. However, it could no longer open and close properly. So the blacksmith ground its core components with glowstone into a powder that damages monsters while generating Star Fragments.
card.obsidian_brief: Obsidian's strong armor can withstand zombie attacks.
card.obsidian_starshards: Restores all HP and gains even tougher armor.
card.obsidian_story:
One of the devices Alex found in Steve's leftover device box.
A small note on it says, "This obsidian is artificial".
card.obsidian_advance-9: Star Fragment armor resistance significantly increased
card.pumpkin_brief:
Fires mid-range lasers forward dealing large area damage.
Photosensitive crop, does not attack while sleeping.
card.pumpkin_starshards: Fires medium-damage lasers in three lanes forward (cannot target air).
card.pumpkin_story: Blacksmith picked up Steve's discarded soul furnace. But due to the decreasing monster population in the Overworld, the mob farm can no longer provide enough incendiary ammunition. So he inserted a flashlight made of scarlet metal that can fire piercing lasers repeatedly.
card.pumpkin_advance-9: Attacks slow enemies (Penalty: Cost increased to 150)
card.pumpkin_wan_brief:
Fires high-frequency lasers in all directions (cannot target air).
Must be planted on a Spooky Pumpkin Head.
Photosensitive crop, stops attacking while sleeping.
card.pumpkin_wan_starshards: Creates continuous explosions in the surrounding area for a period of time (upgrading does not expand range, remains effective after death).
card.pumpkin_wan_story: If you find the name "Wide-area Pumpkin Pie" too academic, you can call it by its other name: Fat Ping Wen.
card.small_dispenser_brief:
Small Dispenser fires short-range snowballs.
Photosensitive crop, does not attack while sleeping.
Low-profile device.
card.small_dispenser_story:
A device Alex found at the entrance of a cave. Written on it: "The snowballs have stones inside. Don't ask."
Blacksmith: This should be one of the devices Steve left behind.
card.small_dispenser_advance-7: Does not sleep when planted in strong light
card.tnt_brief:
TNT deals high explosive damage in a 3x3 area.
Cannot use Star Fragments.
card.tnt_story:
Blacksmith: The village doesn't have enough string left to make TNT fuses, so you don't need to manually detonate it.
Alex: I'm guessing the developer doesn't want to implement a 'trigger' mechanic.
card.tnt_advance-7: Leaves behind cluster bombs at the explosion site for a short time, exploding again after 3 seconds
card.tnt_mines_brief: TNT Mines, after an arming period, can blow away approaching zombies.
card.tnt_mines_starshards: Generates two pre-armed TNT Mines forward.
card.tnt_mines_story:
One of the devices Alex found in Steve's leftover device box. Written on it: "Why does TNT Mines need time to arm? That's truly an eternal mystery. If it could be instantaneous, what would there be to fear? But in its opinion, this is perfectly normal. In its words, 'I was sleeping!'"
Blacksmith: Such a violent mine qwq
card.pumpkin_passport_brief:
Pumpkin Passport covers the device in the same tile and takes damage in its place (2500 HP).
Low-profile device.
card.pumpkin_passport_starshards:
Restores full HP and enters spike state; while spiked, every melee hit reflects half of the damage back to the attacker.
If already spiked, the skill only restores HP.
card.pumpkin_passport_story:
Blacksmith: This pumpkin shell has a stamp on it that says, "Holders of this pass shall not enter."
Alex: Its review process is really strict.
card.balloon_tnt_brief:
Balloon TNT inflates briefly and then floats up to intercept airborne enemies.
Inflation takes 6s; once full it is no longer a low-profile device and only flying monsters can set it off (ground zombies can walk underneath or eat it).
Low-profile device (until fully inflated).
card.balloon_tnt_starshards: Instantly finishes inflation and sends a Balloon TNT clone flying to the right (200 HP); it explodes on the first monster it meets or at the far right edge.
card.balloon_tnt_story:
Blacksmith: Tie TNT to a balloon and it can go find trouble on its own.
Alex: Provided it doesn't get eaten halfway.
card.triple_dispenser_brief: Fires 1/1/1 bullets forward across three lanes respectively.
card.triple_dispenser_starshards: Scatters 240 arrows in a fan-shaped area forward (Satsuka Gekishou).
card.triple_dispenser_story:
Triple Dispenser is modified by the Blacksmith from the cursed villager's Triple Dispenser, solving the original arrow spread problem. Occupying only one tile, it can attack three lanes.
Blacksmith: This is the most powerful fully automatic dispenser device I've ever developed.
Alex: I beg to differ.
Blacksmith: It just hasn't been activated yet.
card.triple_dispenser_advance-3: Fires 1/2/1 bullets forward across three lanes respectively
card.triple_dispenser_advance-7: Fires 2/2/2 bullets forward across three lanes respectively

stage.cp1:
This story takes place in the second year after Steve and the Cursed Villager left for the Eternal Night Swamp. Alex was an adventuring companion of Steve's in the past. They returned to the village where they started at the end of their journey and helped the villagers build various mob farm machines. Now staying behind to guard the village, she is deeply worried about Steve's safety... 
At the same time, monster spawn rates across the Overworld have plummeted. Mob farm outputs have decreased, machines are shutting down due to raw material shortages, and the industrialized village faces the problem of being unable to support its massive villager population. It's time to step up and solve this anomaly.
stage.sg1:
Since Steve left, the number of monsters raiding the village has been decreasing day by day.

      - Alex: Blacksmith, ever since Steve started his adventure last year, the monster population in the Overworld seems to be getting smaller. Does this mean Steve and the others are encountering more monsters?
      - Blacksmith: I suspect you're right. Steve might indeed be in serious trouble. Although he's very strong and has the Librarian by his side, even if that Librarian is always a bit crazy.
      - Alex: Whether related or not, the spawn rate decrease is definitely connected to their adventure. We need to help them and find the source of this anomaly! Using these leftover devices!
      - Blacksmith: Wait, those damn monsters are coming. Now place your devices to fend them off, and relearn your experience from the past.

  - Level Features:

      - Starting Energy: 100, daytime start, automatic energy generation.
      - Start Bonus: 2 Dispensers in Column 1, 3 Furnaces in Column 2.
stage.sg2:
Alex: That was easy. Remember how village raids used to bring overwhelming hordes with so many monster types? Now just these stragglers. Do you remember when Steve and the others left? They were so excited showing off a map, pointing at the Eternal Night Swamp, saying that going there would lead to the legendary Gensokyo.
Blacksmith: Yes, but now that place has been turned into a witch's hut, and the construction crew found no signs of dimensional fluctuations. However, I do know of another possible entrance to a spatial channel... a nearby cave. A few days ago, some villagers reported unknown biological activity there.

After entrusting village defense to automated devices and other villagers, Alex and the Blacksmith set off towards the cave.

   - Alex: Look at all those zombies gathered at the entrance. Some of them are glowing. I have a feeling defeating them will grant us important items that can temporarily enhance our plants' abilities.

  - Level Features:

      - Starting Energy: 50, daytime start, automatic energy generation.
      - Start Bonus: 3 Furnaces in Column 2.
stage.sg3:
After clearing the monsters gathered around the cave entrance, the two continued forward.

      - Alex: The spawn rate inside the cave is not just a little bit different from the outside world - it's nearly ten times what it would be with a spawner in the old Overworld.
      - Blacksmith: It seems the disappearance of monsters across the entire Overworld is connected to the secrets buried deep in this cave. Let's continue. Also, if you find your current devices struggling against these monsters, you can use raw materials to upgrade them with me.
      - Alex: Ah, thanks so much for the help! Just keep moving forward; as long as we don't stop, the road will... extend endlessly? Ugh, the solar panels have stopped working in this pitch-black place. Good thing the photosensitive plants can start functioning now.

  - Level Features:

     - Starting Energy: 100, nighttime start, no automatic energy generation.
     - Start Bonus: 2 Small Dispensers in Column 5.
stage.sg4:
As they go deeper into the cave, the view opens up. The monsters appearing here are stronger and more numerous.

      - Blacksmith: How strange. The Moonlight Generator chose this moment to break. Otherwise, I would have given it to you in the last level.
	- Alex: That's inevitable. The Moonlight Generator needs moonlight to generate power, and it's pitch black in this cave.
- Blacksmith: But fortunately, I gathered some parts and modified it. Now it can work automatically, although...
      - Alex: Although what?
      - Blacksmith: Although you need external force to keep cranking it.
      - Alex: Sweat... So are you going to crank it? I certainly wouldn't dare.
      - Blacksmith: Isn't there a monster to help us crank it? Just plant it in front. By the way, if you collect enough materials, you can come to me to expand your device backpack and unlock the 7th card slot.

  - Level Features:

     - Starting Energy: 50, nighttime start, no automatic energy generation.
     - Start Bonus: 2 Biomass Generators in Column 6.
stage.sg5:
Moving forward, a natural lake formed from underground water blocks the path.

      - Blacksmith: Don't panic. Use the newly acquired Water Lily to carry devices. Also, if you have extra materials, you can expand to the 8th card slot in the shop.
	- Alex: Honestly, rather than expanding my backpack, I'd rather upgrade my devices... but I don't seem to have enough materials.
	- Blacksmith: My ender chest still has some materials that were meant to be sold to other villages. If you need them, you can buy them with some gold coins.

  - Level Features:

      - Terrain: Lanes 3 and 4 are water lanes.
     - Starting Energy: 50, nighttime start, no automatic energy generation.
     - Start Bonus: 4 Water Lilies on the water lanes in Columns 1 and 2.
stage.sg6:
After clearing the remaining monsters in the cave's water layer, they found a fissure in the lake leading deeper, from which iridescent light scattered.

      - Blacksmith: This brilliant light can't be something our Minecraft lighting can render. I have a feeling there's a connection to another dimension down there.
      - Alex: Let's move!
      - (Both put on Turtle Shell Helmets dropped by turtle zombies and dive deep. At first, it's so narrow only one person can pass. After swimming dozens of steps further, the area opens up. Iridescent dragon pearls are embedded in the cave walls.)
      - Alex: These aren't Minecraft ores!
	- Blacksmith: But their light intensity is even enough to drive the solar panels.
      - (From the depths comes a monster's roar, mixed with low sighs.)
      - Blacksmith: Looks like another tough battle is ahead.

  - Level Features:

     - Starting Energy: 50, daytime start, automatic energy generation.
     - The spawn strength multiplier rises to 1.6 from wave 25.
stage.sg7:
[Difficulty still being balanced]

      - Alex: Damn, these mutated zombies are really tough.
      - Blacksmith: I think these dragon pearls from another world are causing the zombie mutations. We'd better not stay here too long.
      - Alex: There must be clues here leading to the other world.
      - (The two search for a long time without success and return to the mine tunnel.)
      - Alex: Ah, so this cave has no connection to that Gensokyo after all~
      - Blacksmith: Based on my exploration experience, uhh... (Suddenly, a giant obsidian block appears before them.) Was this rock blocking the way before? (He picks up his iron pickaxe and strikes it.)
      - (The sound of striking attracts monsters.)
      - Alex: Watch out, here come the monsters. Thank goodness the devices we placed earlier haven't been collected. I'll hold them off.

  - Level Features:

      - Starting Energy: 50, nighttime start, no automatic energy generation.
     - Start Bonus: 2 Small Dispensers in Column 5 and 2 Furnaces in Column 2.
     - The spawn strength multiplier rises to 2 from wave 21.

  - Elite Wave Story:

      - Alex: Finally dealt with those monsters again. Blacksmith, how's it going on your end?
      - (Silence)
      - Alex: Blacksmith! Blacksmith! Damn, what is that black thing?
      - (Obsidian Golem appears as the elite in the final wave.)
stage.sg8:
Alex discovers that the Obsidian Golem has trapped the Blacksmith in obsidian. After an intense battle, Alex successfully rescues the Blacksmith. Before being overwhelmed by monsters, they break through the obsidian wall and discover a hidden cavity, inside which stands an Enchanted Netherite Pickaxe.

      - Alex: Wow! Treasure enchantment - Efficiency VI: Review Draft!
      - Blacksmith: Remember that strange obsidian in the iridescent cave? I think we can use this pickaxe to dig a path further down. Also, this leftover obsidian is very useful. If you collect more obsidian, come to me to unlock advanced devices.
      - (The two return to the water layer lake. The surface is covered with black tendrils.)
      - Alex: Who knew there was such a different world down here in this cave.
      - Blacksmith: Strange, this terrain wasn't here when we came before.
      - Alex: Oh, this is the new 1.18 cave update. We've defeated too many monsters, and the overflow of experience causes a block called 'Sculk Catalyst' to spread.
      - Blacksmith: Why do I feel like my vision is flickering? What's that screaming thing?
      - Alex: STOP! It's sensitive to sound!!!!!

  - Level Features:

      - Terrain: Lanes 3 and 4 are water lanes.
      - Starting Energy: 100, nighttime start, no automatic energy generation.
      - Start Bonus: 4 Water Lilies on the water lanes in Columns 1 and 2.
      - Final wave: Warden (BOSS).
stage.sg9:
After a fierce battle, the two finally defeat the Warden.

      - Blacksmith: That sound wave from the Warden nearly burst my eardrums.
      - Alex: There, there. Now Gensokyo is within reach. Just use this 'Review Draft'...
      - (Monster roars in the distance)
      - Alex: Looks like those monsters aren't going to let us leave so easily.

 - Level Features:
      - Starting Energy: 100, daytime start, automatic energy generation; generation stops when the Centipede appears.
      - The spawn strength multiplier rises to 2 from wave 21 and to 3 from wave 35.

  - [After the vanguard wave]

      - Alex: Woo, those fools who tried to stop us have been annihilated by our steel devices. Now we can destroy the obsidian.
      - (1st strike, the obsidian doesn't budge)
      - Alex: Huh?
      - Blacksmith: From my observation, the obsidian is mixed with divine ore. Even 'Review Draft' needs several strikes.
      - (10th strike, cracks appear)
      - Alex: It's working, yay!
      - (Gravel shatters around them, an abyss opens beneath their feet, collapse echoes through the cave)
      - Alex: Hey, wait!
      - Blacksmith: Hold on, here they come again.

  - [Elite Wave 1: Obsidian Golem appears]

      - Alex: Oh no, not him again!

  - [Elite Wave 2: Warden appears]

      - Blacksmith: Why is my vision flickering again?
      - Alex: Our fighting was too loud and triggered the Sculk Shrieker. The Warden is back!

  - [Final BOSS Wave: Centipede appears]

      - Alex: Looks like those mobs have calmed down again. Review Draft... activate!
      - (The sound of digging echoes, followed by rustling noises)

  - [Mysterious character appears]

      - ???: Finally found you here! You block monsters trying to invade Gensokyo. Take this!
      - Blacksmith: Alex, watch out!

goods.slot8_description: Expands the device backpack again, giving you more tactical options in water stages.
goods.slot9_description: Unlocks the final expanded card slot so you can prepare a fuller device lineup for elite battles.
goods.chapter1_kit_description: A supply kit from the blacksmith. Grants a random mix of leather and iron ingots. Can be bought repeatedly.
goods.scarletborder_crystal_description: A high-energy crystal from the Scarlet Border. In this version, it is used to unlock certain advanced devices.
goods.pumpkin_wan_shop_description: Unlocks Wide-area Pumpkin Pie. It must be planted on a Spooky Pumpkin Head and fires high-frequency lasers around itself.
goods.at_dispenser_shop_description: Unlocks the Anti-Tank Turret. It must be planted on a Dispenser and excels at destroying long-range armored targets.
goods.chapter2_plants_description: Unlocks Chapter 2 expansion devices: Elastic Pudding, Dual Dispenser, and Glowstone Powder.

Note! This is a test version of "MVZ443".
Test versions do not represent the final quality of the product. Thank you for your understanding and support. Good luck!

    Unlock more devices by completing levels. Current progress reaches Chapter 1 Stage 8. The story is still being refined. Balance and levels may change multiple times during iterations.
    
    The multiplayer feature in this beta version is in testing. Please search for the multiplayer tutorial on the game documentation page for more details.
